name: dobe_push6_lean
desc: pink goo doberman hugging someone is pushed away and leans its head and body far backward toward the viewer, but its bent hugging arm on the right stays exactly in place and does not move at all, only the upper arm stretches like goo, its lower body and drips stay still stuck to the goo pillar, sticky goo ropes stretch and sag, head drops back with a calm closed-eye faint smirk, smooth motion
